subject: Renewal + expansion recap — ACME Analytics usage & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion recap — ACME Analytics usage & next steps

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our renewal/expansion conversation and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned.

TL;DR
- Current priority: stabilize inference latency for batch scoring jobs and reduce per-token cost for high-volume reranking.
- New workload: pilot near-real-time document ingestion + reranking for search personalization (target: 200 qps peak).
- Recommended path: short pilot on Dedicated capacity + Redwood Optimize recommendations -> scale to Reserved capacity if pilot metrics meet SLOs.

What we covered (notes):
1) Usage & billing snapshot
   - Monthly tokens (approx): 1.8B tokens (Feb) — spike during batch scoring windows (2x baseline).
   - Current inefficiencies: inconsistent batching on client side, KV cache misses for long-context reranks.
2) Primary pain points
   - Latency spikes impacting SLA for downstream customers during nightly batch runs.
   - Cost creep on heavy reranking jobs.
3) Proposed short-term fixes (2–6 weeks)
   - Quick wins: enable prefix/KV caching in the integration and tweak batch sizes (Vivek can help with instrumentation).
   - Pilot: 2-week Dedicated pilot for reranking pipeline (we’ll provide a tailored SKU proposal).
4) Long-term plan (Q2)
   - If pilot hits latency and cost targets, move to Reserved Dedicated capacity + 24/7 on-call SLA.

Open questions / asks for ACME
- Confirm priority order: (1) latency at peak batch windows, (2) cost for reranking, (3) new real-time workload.
- Any data residency or compliance constraints for the pilot?
- Stakeholders for legal/procurement to loop for contract amendment.

Attachments: redwood-usage-report-2026-02.pdf (initial run-through), proposed-sku-plan-acme-2026Q2.xlsx (SKU + estimate).

Next steps (owners & timeline)
- This week: Vivek to schedule a 60-min tech deep dive with ACME infra/ML eng (proposed dates below).
- Next 2 weeks: run a 2-week Dedicated pilot (engineering + Redwood support).
- End of Q2: contract amendment / Reserved capacity decision if pilot successful.

Proposed deep-dive slots (PT):
- Thu 2026-03-05 09:00–10:00
- Fri 2026-03-06 13:00–14:00

Olivia — can you confirm which slot works best and share procurement contact(s)?

Thanks,

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>, Rajesh Varma <rajesh.varma@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 09:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion recap — ACME Analytics usage & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Priority: we agree with the order you listed, but to be explicit: batch latency (customer-facing SLAs) is the immediate blocker. Reranking cost is secondary. The real-time workload is a strategic initiative for Q3, but we'd like a pilot in Q2.

2) Compliance/data residency: for the pilot we can keep data in US regions. No additional constraints right now, but we will confirm if procurement needs more detail.

3) Procurement contact: procurement@acmeanalytics.com (CC'd). Legal/contract person is Rajesh (CC).

Slot: Thu 2026-03-05 09:00–10:00 PT works for engineering (I'll get Ravi from infra to join).

Can you also share a ballpark monthly cost delta for the proposed Dedicated pilot vs. current hosted usage? Our CFO wants a back-of-envelope before we commit the calendar time.

Best,
Olivia
Director of Product, ACME Analytics
olivia.chen@acmeanalytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 07:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion recap — ACME Analytics usage & next steps

Perfect — thanks Olivia, noted the slot and stakeholders.

Ballpark pilot economics (very rough):
- 2-week Dedicated pilot (baseline): equivalent to ~0.5–0.8x of your current peak daily spend, depending on instance sizing and KV/cache tuning.
- If pilot reduces token spend by ~25% (via caching + batching), expected monthly run-rate savings on reranking could be material (we'll model this formally).

Attached: proposed-sku-plan-acme-2026Q2.xlsx (contains two SKU options and a sample back-of-envelope). Also attached the redwood-usage-report-2026-02.pdf we discussed.

Owners & immediate actions
- Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood): lead tech deep dive and pilot instrumentation.
- Stephanie Nguyen (Redwood): finance/billing point for amendment and pricing.
- Olivia / Ravi (ACME): provide a short list of prod test data and a small access window for the pilot.

I'll create a shared drive folder and upload the pilot checklist + runbook after the call. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ACME-4732.

See you Thu 09:00 PT.

Thanks,
Marissa

—
